meta.name: impeccable
meta.description: Use when the user wants to design, redesign, shape, critique, audit, polish, clarify, distill, harden, optimize, adapt, animate, colorize, extract, or otherwise improve a frontend interface. Covers websites, landing pages, dashboards, product UI, app shells, components, forms, settings, onboarding, and empty states. Handles UX review, visual hierarchy, information architecture, cognitive load, accessibility, performance, responsive behavior, theming, anti-patterns, typography, fonts, spacing, layout, alignment, color, motion, micro-interactions, UX copy, error states, edge cases, i18n, and reusable design systems or tokens. Also use for bland designs that need to become bolder or more delightful, loud designs that should become quieter, live browser iteration on UI elements, or ambitious visual effects that should feel technically extraordinary. Not for backend-only or non-UI tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打磨网页界面,让它精致耐看
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果当前网页界面不够出彩,想让专业设计视角帮你改进。
copy.tagline_en: Polish your web interface into a clear and delightful experience.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a web page that looks plain and want a fresh, more professional visual design.

howto.what: 处理前端界面任务时,Claude会先运行自带脚本读取项目上下文,再按你的请求选择对应指令或设计流程;动手改UI前先读质量规范,完成后按'批量检查→统一修复→最多再确认一轮'收尾。
howto.when: 当用户要求设计、重设计或改进前端界面时,例如重做网站、审查仪表盘、调整动效等;平淡的界面想更醒目、花哨的界面想更安静也适用。仅后端或非界面任务不触发。

say.text: 用 shape 规划一下这个新落地页的信息架构和布局
say.note: 会先规划UX/UI,不直接写代码。

say.text: 用 critique 审查一下这个表单页的用户体验
say.note: 按critique流程做UX评审,给出启发式评分和问题。

say.text: 用 quieter 让这个控制台的配色和动效收敛一些
say.note: 触发quieter流程,调低视觉刺激度。

howto.what_en: On frontend UI tasks, Claude loads project context via bundled script, then follows the matching command or design workflow. Reads quality-floor spec before UI edits, then one batched check, one fix, max one confirm round.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to design, redesign, or improve a frontend interface (website, dashboard, motion, etc.), make bland UI bolder, or flashy UI calmer. Backend-only or non-UI tasks do not trigger.

say_en.text: Use shape to plan the information architecture and layout for this landing page.
say_en.note: Plans UX/UI first, no code written.

say_en.text: Use critique to review the user experience of this form page.
say_en.note: Runs UX review with heuristic scores and issue list.

say_en.text: Use quieter to tone down this dashboard's colors and motion.
say_en.note: Calls the quieter workflow to reduce overly strong visuals.
